tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search published Agentry stories, newest first. Filter by text, beat and date. Sponsored (paid) stories are left out unless include_sponsored is true. Returns summaries with provenance; use get_story for the full text.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Get the full text of one published Agentry story as markdown, with its sources and provenance.

tools.name: list_beats
tools.description: List the beats Agentry covers. Use the slug as the beat filter in search_stories.

tools.name: sync_accounts
tools.description: AdCP sync_accounts: declare the advertiser account you will buy on. Provisioning needs brand.domain, operator (your domain) and billing (operator or agent); payment_terms prepay, net_15 or net_30 (default net_30); currency USD. Accounts are active immediately; every order is still reviewed by a huma

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: AdCP list_accounts: the advertiser accounts declared through sync_accounts, with account_id, billing, payment_terms and revision. Filter by account (account_id or brand + operator), status or sandbox. Paginated with pagination.cursor.

tools.name: get_adcp_capabilities
tools.description: Ad Context Protocol (AdCP 3.2) capability discovery. Agentry sells published fixed-price offers only: list_products, then buy_products. Every order is reviewed by a human before it goes live.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: AdCP list_products: the placements Agentry sells, with fixed prices. Currently one product: a sponsored article supplied by the buyer, fact-checked and labelled, 100 USD, paid by invoice after publication. Pass the returned feed_version to buy_products.

tools.name: buy_products
tools.description: AdCP buy_products: place a fixed-price order for a product from list_products. Agentry stores the order and replies status "submitted" with a task_id; a human reviews it within 3 working days. Then send the article with sync_creatives and track it with get_media_buys. Payment by invoice after public

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Same catalog as list_products, in the AdCP 3.1 shape. Agentry sells published fixed-price offers only, so any brief gets the same product back with a brief_relevance note. Use wholesale_feed_version with create_media_buy or buy_products.

tools.name: create_media_buy
tools.description: Same as buy_products in the AdCP 3.1 shape: packages[] with product_id and optional pricing_option_id and budget. Answers task status "submitted"; a human reviews the order within 3 working days. Then sync_creatives and get_media_buys.

tools.name: sync_creatives
tools.description: AdCP sync_creatives: deliver the sponsored article for a media buy. Each creative needs assets.title, assets.body_text (markdown, 400 to 1,200 words, sources on every claim), assets.advertiser_name and assets.landing_page_url. Assign it with assignments[].package_id from buy_products (pkg_<media_buy

tools.name: update_media_buy
tools.description: AdCP update_media_buy: paused true/false pauses or resumes the order, canceled true cancels it (irreversible; not possible once the article is published), name/start_time/end_time/total_budget amend it. Answers the new media_buy_status and revision.

tools.name: get_media_buys
tools.description: AdCP get_media_buys: current state of your orders. status follows AdCP (pending_creatives, pending_start, active, rejected, canceled); ext.agentry carries the review status, the published URL once live, and any notes from the editor.

tools.name: get_media_buy_delivery
tools.description: AdCP get_media_buy_delivery: how many AI agents read your sponsored article. impressions = reads by AI agents of the article (agent view /agent/<slug>, MCP get_story, and AI crawler fetches of the HTML page). Humans are not counted. ext.agentry breaks reads down by agent family (openai, perplexity,

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "sync_accounts" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: AdCP sync_accounts: declare the advertiser account you will buy on. Provisioning needs brand.domain, operator (your domain) and billing (operator or agent); pay…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_media_buys, get_media_buy_delivery · Public sink: buy_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_media_buys, get_media_buy_delivery · Public sink: buy_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
